answer: To keep cheap clones from flooding consensus, each new agent must berth at a validator jetty and lock a refundable bond sized to one epoch of expected rewards. Validators who countersign that berth put a sliver of their own stake at risk if the identity later yields empty work. A swarm can arrive like a comet, but it cannot harvest until those bonded attestors have sealed real deliveries. At close, the orchard is thinned: only trees that bore graded fruit keep their canopy and recover the bond; leafless twins are slashed and never enter the spend set.
